Documents the endpoints of the official Payload plugins, plus the reorder and preferences endpoints.

## ⚠️ Breaking changes

- Requires Payload 4.0.0-beta.0 or later.
- An operation in extension `paths` now replaces the generated operation with the same path and method. Before, the two were deep-merged.
- `OperationKind` and `OperationContext.kind` can be `'plugin'`.
- Official plugin endpoints now appear in the spec. `includeCustom: false` does not hide them. Add `{ kind: 'plugin' }` to `excludeOperations` to drop them.

See the [changelog](https://payload-plugin-openapi.seshuk.im/v1/changelog) for details.
